items.text: Kosodi kanen, kemoion Isaak, kowariwarete da akekonye, komam epedori aanyun, konyarau Esau okokuke Iosodit, kotema atiar, “Ikakoku.” Kobala ebe, “Eoŋ lo.”
Kotema atiar, “Koany, amoion eoŋ, mam ajeni apaaran naatwania.
Aso kwana kenainait, kitin lumeias, ekonieoe, ka akonikabwa, kolot ais, komejak imejauna;
Kitemok akiriŋ naejijim, kwape akotor, koinu, kanyam; kasodi kelipak jo arereŋ eroko eoŋ ketwana.”
Kiira Rebeka nueneras Isaak kaEsau ikekoku. Kolot Esau ais amejaun imejauna, ka ayaun da.
Kolimok Rebeka Yakob ikekoku ebe, “Koany, apup papakon elimokini onacekon Esau ebe,
‘Koinunai imeiauna kitemok akiriŋ naejijim, kanyam, kelipak jo arereŋ kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT eroko eoŋ ketwana.’
Aso ikakoku, kiira ekaporoto kwape ejaatar ŋun nukeeorakini.
Kolot kwana osipan loka akinei, koinu ikaalei iarei luejok; etemokini eoŋ da kes araun akiriŋ naejijimikini papakon, kwape ekotor:
Iinari ijo papakon, konyam, kosodi kilipak jo arereŋ eroko ketwana.”
Kotema Yakob totoke Rebeka atiar, “Koany, erai onaeeka Esau etuŋanan loecekit, konye arurut eoŋ.
Elemuni papaka kararapana, araun eoŋ da ekeŋalan kamake; kasodi ailamakinio kwabo mere aisirerenio.’
Kotema totoke atiar, “Kabeik eoŋ akoniilamakinio, ikakoku; na bon, kiira ekaporoto, ape koomikinai.”
Kolot, koom, koinu totoke: kitemok totoke akiriŋ naeiiiim, kwape akotor papake.
Kolem Rebeka inapen luejok luka Esau ekiyaike, luajaas kaŋes togo, kitanap nul Yakob okokuke lodidi:
Kitanapanak imukulen luka ikaalei akaninike, omurisiŋike da nearurut.
Koinak okokuke Yakob akiriŋ naejijim ka inyamat luetemokinit akaninike.
Kobu neejai papake, kotema atiar, “Ipapa.” Kobala ebe, “Eoŋ lo; iŋai bo ijo, ikakoku?”
Kotema Yakob papake atiar, “Eoŋ Esau ekiyaikon; ido eswama kwape ibu kieorakinia; kenainait, konyou, kiboikin, konyam imejaunaka, kosodi kilipak eoŋ arereŋ.’
Kotema Isaak okokuke atiar, “Ikonakini ai isunyari adumun kwaŋin, ikakoku?” Kobala ebe, “Naarai EJAKAIT Ekonideke ŋes ketusunyaari.”
Kobala Isaak Yakob ebe, “Kenainait kikunyu, kararapana, ikakoku, arai kito ijo ikakoku Esau eut cut, arai mere.”
Kikunyak Yakob neejai Isaak papake; korarapana, kiner ebe, “Eporoto erai eporoto loka Yakob, konye do akanin eraas akanin nuka Esau.”
Mam abu komisiik, naarai acekitos akaninike, kwape kakanin nuka onaeeke Esau: kosodi ailipakin arereŋ.
Kotema atiar, “Ŋoŋ ikokuka Esau eut?” Kosodi ebe, “Eoŋ lopelo.”
Kotema atiar, “Kisukunyikinai, kanyam imejauna yenika ikokuka, kasodi kelipak arereŋ.” Kisukunyik neejai, konyam: koinu ajon da, komat,
Kosodi Isaak papake kotema ŋes atiar, “Ikakoku, kikunyu do, konu eoŋ.”
Kikunyak konu: kinu elos loka anapitoke, kilipak arereŋ, kotema atiar,
Kosodi kanen, nepedauni Isaak ailipakin Yakob arereŋ, korai Yakob da anyoun ŋipeŋin kaneejai papake Isaak, kobonuni do Esau onaeeke kotoma amej.
Kipo ŋesi da akiriŋ naeiijim koinu papake; kotema papake atiar, “Ipapa konyou ca bo, konyam imejauna yenika okokukon, kosodi kilipak arereŋ.”
Isaak papake kotema ŋes atiar, “Iŋai bo ijo?” Kotema atiar, “Eoŋ ikonikoku yenikiyai, Esau.”
Komaran Isaak noi noi, kotema atiar, “Aso iŋai bo nol lokemejauni imejauna kainu: anyam eoŋ kere eroko ijo kebuno, kasodi ailipakin arereŋ? Eebo, isirerenio ŋes da.”
Kiira Esau akiro nuka papake, kikiliar aimony noi, kiutie, kobala papake ebe, “Okwe ipapa, kilipakinai eoŋ da arereŋ, eoŋ da, ba.”
Kotema atiar, “Abu onacekon kobu iŋalai, ido kidemak arerenukon.”

Kotema atiar, “Mam aponi komaikinai ejok ekekiror Yakob? Naarai alomaki nukan irwan nu kere aarei; abukadema apolouka; ido koany, natikwana da kadema akareren.” Kotema atiar, “Mam kideikinit eoŋ da adiorerene”
Koboŋok Isaak kotema Esau atiar, “Koany, adakak ŋes ayait jo, ainak da iinacanake kere mama ejai aijaanakin; ido esimii ŋes akima ka aion, aso anyoika nukasubakini jo ikakoku?”
Kotema Esau papake atiar, “Ejai jo arereŋ adiopet bon ipapa? Okwe ipapa, kilipakinai eoŋ da arereŋ, eoŋ da ba.” Kodelo Esau, komony.
Kosac Esau Yakob kanuka arereŋ naelipakin ŋes papake. Kotema Esau kotauke atiar, “Eapiete apaarasia nuka aimony papaka; kasodi aiar onaceka Yakob.”
Kolimokinai Rebeka akiro nuka Esau okokuke lokapolon; kijuka, konyarau Yakob okokuke lodidi, kotema atiar, “Koany, onacekon Esau, toma akirokon, italakaara naarai inerunit aiar joo
Aso kwana, okokuka, kiira ekaporoto; konyou, koker Karan mama ejai Laban onaceka;
Kiboioror kaŋes apaarasia adis aitodol neinonaror adedeŋ naka onacekon;
Aitodol neinoŋaror anyunyura naka onacekon, kimurwokis da nuiswamak ŋes; ŋes ejukunia anyaraun jo kaŋina; kanukinyo tikademarere eoŋ yes kere kotoma apaaran adiopet?”
Kotema Rebeka Isaak atiar, “Apas aijaraka kanuka apesur nuka Ket: arai kemany Yakob da aberu kotoma apesur nuka Ket, nuesubitos bala ŋun. Kotoma apesuru nuka akwap kana, iŋarakinete akaijar biai?”
